description: Governed test library for the QA-Pilot validation framework. All tests are advisory-only. Test results do not confer authority, seal, or approval.

regression.description: Regression tests derived from sealed work orders, acceptance gates, and evidence plane invariants

security.description: Security boundary tests: mutation path absence, evidence isolation, authority separation, scoring integrity

uat.description: User acceptance test workflows: onboarding, owner review, AI agent boundary reception

accessibility.description: Accessibility conformance tests: keyboard navigation, contrast, screen reader semantics

performance.description: Performance baseline tests (future: startup, SDK latency, validation throughput)

ai.description: AI qualification benchmarks: instruction adherence, governance awareness, hallucination resistance

compliance.description: Regulatory compliance evidence mappings (future: SOC 2, PIPEDA, EU AI Act)
